overall: Atlanta has warmed steadily through the day, reaching 87.8°F by 15:50 ET with the running max plateauing over the last 50 minutes at exactly 87.8°F and velocity stalled at +0.0°F/hr. Best estimate is a daily high in the 88.0–88.3°F range with moderate-to-high confidence, anchored heavily by the current observed plateau.
